arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' AND p.line = 'Hydraulics'
